hints.title: Daily Upward Price Accumulation
hints.text: Multiple transactions are allowed. Any multi-day price increase from day a to day b equals the sum of consecutive daily gains between those days.

hints.title: Local Price Difference Invariant
hints.text: Capturing every positive daily price difference prices[i] minus prices[i - 1] guarantees the maximum total profit across all valid transactions.

hints.title: Positive Increment Summation Procedure
hints.text: Initialize profit to zero. Traverse prices starting from index 1. If prices[i] is greater than prices[i - 1], add the difference to profit. Return the total profit accumulated.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively checking whether to buy, hold, or sell at each day takes exponential O(2^N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedily accumulating every upward slope processes prices in O(N) time and requires O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should clearly explain why summing every positive daily difference is equivalent to executing ideal multi-day transactions.
